description:
Read the stored page of one URL a crawl kept, in the crawl's output_format. Works only for crawls created with an output_format, and only for results whose content_status is fetched.

Pass crawl_id and content_id: a content id, or content_url from a crawl_results row. Returns the page
as stored — raw HTML for output_format "html", Markdown for "markdown" — cut to max_chars (default
20000); a final note says when it was cut. To read a page the crawl did not
store, use scrape on its URL instead.

content_id.description: A content id (ct_…), or content_url from a crawl_results row; its last path segment is the id

max_chars.description: Max characters of the page to return (default 20000)

name: crawl_content
